mapper.select: select p.id as id, p.title as title, p.name as name, p.component as component, p.path as path, p.icon as icon, p.status as status, p.type as type, p.parent_id as parentId, p.sort as sort from acl_permission p where p.is_deleted = 0 and p.id in (select ar.permission_id from acl_role_permission ar where ar.role_id = #{id})
